exit.label: Leave the game
exit.title: Leave this story?
exit.text: Your story will be put away. You can start another one whenever you like.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.intro: Pick a challenge, take it on by playing, and win a card that is all yours.

voice.title: Voice and help
voice.voiceHint: Stories and hints can be heard.
voice.hintsHint: A gentle hint when you think for a while.
voice.sample: Hello! I am your voice for the stories. Ready to go?
voice.noVoice: No voice found on this device.
voice.tapToHear: Tap the screen to hear it.

account.title: Who is playing?
account.hint: Switch player, or sign the device out. When a grown-up signs out, everything the device remembered is erased.

done.noCard: No card this time. You need at least {pct}% right answers to win it. Play this chapter again, you can do it!
done.missed: You found {right} right answer{right, plural, one {} other {s}} out of {total}. Not quite yet, and that is fine: we learn by trying. Come back later and we will do it together. You need {pct}% right answers to win the card.
